Container.Name: TelltaleDNS
Container.Overview:
TelltaleDNS is a filtering, encrypted, observable DNS resolver. It blocks ads and trackers per device, forwards to encrypted upstreams (DoT, DoH, DoQ), and shows who asked what and why it answered the way it did. One static binary in a small image, with the web UI built in.
Put a telltale.toml in the config folder (a starter is linked in the README) or leave it empty for the built-in defaults. After the first start, open the web UI and sign in with the setup token from data/setup-token (or the container log), or set the bootstrap admin variables below. Then point your router's DHCP DNS server at the container's IP.
Container.Requires: A free IP address on your LAN for the container (Network type br0), or nothing else on the Unraid host using port 53 if you switch to bridge or host networking.

Config.Name: DNS (UDP)
Config.Description: DNS over UDP. Only used with bridge networking; on br0 the container listens on its own IP.

Config.Name: DNS (TCP)
Config.Description: DNS over TCP. Only used with bridge networking.

Config.Name: Web UI and API
Config.Description: The web UI, REST API, and health endpoints.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Holds telltale.toml (read when it exists; otherwise the built-in defaults apply). Mounted read-only.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Lists, the query log, users, and the setup token. The only path TelltaleDNS writes to.

Config.Name: Secrets
Config.Description: Files for *_file settings in telltale.toml (for example password_file = "/run/secrets/smtp-password"), kept out of the config. Mounted read-only.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: error, warn, info, debug, or trace.

Config.Name: Bootstrap admin user
Config.Description: Optional: creates this admin on first start, instead of signing in with the setup token. Ignored once any user exists.

Config.Name: Bootstrap admin password
Config.Description: Password for the bootstrap admin. Unraid keeps it in the saved template, so prefer the hash below, or clear it after the first start.

Config.Name: Bootstrap admin password hash
Config.Description: Argon2id hash instead of the password, from: echo 'a long passphrase' | docker run --rm -i ghcr.io/paimonsoror/telltale auth hash-password
